model_annotations.Bulgarian: The diagram is a circular chart that compares different categories of characters. The chart is divided into 3 main sectors and 10 sub-categories, with the main categories being "Real Characters", "Virtual Characters", and "Custom Characters". The "Virtual Characters" category is the largest, occupying roughly half of the chart, and is colored blue, while it is further divided into 4 sub-categories: "Comic Characters", "Characters", "Novel Characters", and "Game Characters", each with a lighter shade of blue. The "Real Characters" category is colored green and takes up around a quarter of the chart, and is further divided into 6 sub-categories: "Influencers", "Actors", "Musicians", "Writers", "Athletes", and "Artists", and "Scientists", each with a different shade of green. The "Custom Characters" category is colored red and takes up a small portion of the chart. The chart does not include a legend or percentage labels, but the size of each sector is visually distinct. Overall, the chart provides a visual representation of the different categories and sub-categories of characters, with varying sizes and colors used to distinguish between them.
model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the distribution of various character categories. There are 13 slices in total, representing different character types. The categories include Comic Characters (light blue, approximately 27%), Virtual Characters (blue, approximately 45%), Custom Characters (red, approximately 4%), and Real Characters (green, approximately 24%), which is further divided into subcategories: Scientists (light pink), Artists (beige), Athletes (light green), Writers (white), Musicians (light green), Actors (light green), and Influencers (light green). The chart visually groups the categories into larger segments, with Virtual Characters being the largest, followed by Comic Characters and Real Characters. The subcategories under Real Characters appear ordered from largest to smallest, although the exact proportions are not explicitly stated. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentage labels are not shown inside the slices. Some slices, such as Virtual Characters, are visually emphasized due to their larger size.
model_annotations.German: Das Kreisdiagramm vergleicht verschiedene Arten von Charakteren. Das Diagramm hat insgesamt 13 Segmente, die in drei Hauptkategorien unterteilt sind. Die größte Kategorie, "Virtual Characters", ist in dunkelblau dargestellt und macht etwa 50 % des Diagramms aus. Darunter fallen "Game Characters", "Novel Characters", "Characters" und "Comic Characters". Die zweite Kategorie, "Real Characters", ist grün dargestellt und macht etwa 25 % des Diagramms aus. Diese Kategorie ist weiter in "Influencers", "Actors", "Musicians", "Writers", "Athletes", "Artists" und "Scientists" unterteilt. Die kleinste Kategorie, "Custom Characters", ist rot dargestellt und macht etwa 5 % des Diagramms aus. Einige Segmente sind mit Prozentangaben beschriftet, aber diese sind nicht lesbar. Das Diagramm hat keine Legende, aber die Farben der Segmente sind unterschiedlich, um die verschiedenen Kategorien visuell zu unterscheiden. Die Segmente sind im Uhrzeigersinn angeordnet, wobei "Comic Characters" oben beginnt.
